name: loot-liquidator-prompt-manager
description: Find, load, and version Loot Liquidator master prompts stored in GitHub, without remembering exact names.

interface.defaultPrompt: Show my Loot Liquidator master prompts
interface.shortDescription: Find and load my master prompts
interface.longDescription: Browse a numbered menu of version-controlled Loot Liquidator prompts in GitHub. Select by number, role, rough spelling, or partial name; retrieve the complete prompt and optionally apply it to the current conversation. Maintain the registry through reviewed GitHub pull requests.
